results.title: Becoming an Envato Author FAQs
label_names: can i sell on my own site
results.body:
Author intake is temporarily paused

We have paused new author applications until further notice. We really appreciate your interest in joining our creative community and apologize for the inconvenience. Please check back intermittently to see when applications may reopen.

  • How do I join Envato as an Author?

    Applications to become an Envato Author are currently closed while we improve our intake process. 

    We don't have a confirmed reopening date yet. When applications do reopen, new authors will be able to apply via our selective intake model for supported content types only.

    If your application is successful, you'll need to complete four steps in your Author Profile before you can start uploading: 

    1. Provide your tax information
    2. Set up your payout details
    3. Complete your trader declaration
    4. Verify your account by completing an ID check.

    Learn more about the Author ID check process.

    In the meantime, you can get ahead by reviewing what we’re looking for and how to succeed: Envato Elements Selection Criteria.

  • How do I upload items?

    Once you've completed your Author Profile setup, you can start uploading by following the instructions below:

    1. Sign in to your Envato account.
    2. Head to your Author Dashboard and click Upload My First Item.
    3. Add your Item Information and Item Presentation requirements so your items are easy for customers to find.
    4. When you’re ready, click Upload.

    Once uploaded, every item submitted to Envato is sent through our review process. We’re looking for great items that work well for customers and follow our quality expectations, including Item Information & Presentation requirements, Technical requirements and Legal requirements.

    Note: Some item types have specialized pathways to make things easier and quicker, especially if you have a lot of items to upload. Learn more about the Uploading Process.

  • How does the review process work and how long does it take to be approved?

    There’s nothing more we want than to see your items live and make sales. However, to ensure that customers have the best experience possible, we have a review process in place to maintain our quality expectations.

    Once your item is uploaded to Envato, it is evaluated and assessed across our main Item Quality areas, including:

    Item Presentation Requirements
    Item Information and Metadata Requirements
    Technical Requirements
    Legal Requirements

    Once assessed by the Quality team, they will be given an approval, soft or hard rejection.

    If approved, your item is published immediately.

    If hard rejected, this means that the Quality team has determined that the item is not suitable for sale on Envato. This can be for a number of reasons but generally, it means that the item is not at the quality level required or it has breached legal content guidelines. If your item has been hard rejected, you cannot resubmit the item.

    If you receive a soft rejection, you will be given the opportunity to correct your item and re-submit based on the notes from the Reviewer (as outlined in the email or comments in the Author Dashboard).

    The current review times across content-types on Envato can depend on a number of factors, such as the amount of items currently in the queue and the available resources of our reviewers. You can view the current average wait times here.

    Learn more about the review process, or see our top review tips and the most common rejection reasons.

  • What kind of items are in demand at the moment?

    Envato regularly publishes trend reports that show market and customer trends on the Author Hub. You can also visit our platforms on Envato Market and Envato Elements, and use the filter option to see what items have sold well, have been recently approved, and what items are trending for inspiration.

  • How much can I earn with Envato?

    While it’s impossible to say exactly how much any one author can earn, Envato is a fantastic opportunity to get your items directly in front of an engaged buyer community. Many authors earn a living from their item sales while doing what they love.

    Learn more about how earnings work.

  • How and when will I get paid?

    Payouts are processed once a month on the 15th of each month. To be paid for the month, you need to set up your payout profile before the 8th of that month and have at least $50 in earnings in your balance.

    To set up payout profile (if you haven't already done this) please follow these steps, or head to our relevant Market and Elements articles for more information.

    1. Access your payout profile:
      • Market: https://themeforest.net/accounts/payouts
      • Elements: https://author.envato/profile/payment
    2. Fill out your general information
    3. Select your payout method—either Bank Transfer or PayPal. If you want to select a virtual provider like Payoneer, Wise or Revolut, you need to select the Bank Transfer option.

    For both Elements and Market, once you have your payout profile set up, you can make changes to your details at any time until the 8th of that month. Do not attempt to change your details during processing days, as this might affect your payment.

    Once your payment has been processed, you will receive an email with the estimated delivery time—which will vary depending on payment method and your location. In most cases, you should receive payment within 1–5 business days of the payout date. However, bank transfers may take longer in some regions, especially for first-time payments.

    Please note: if the 15th day of the month falls on a weekend or an Australian public holiday, then payouts will be processed the following business day

  • What payout options do I have?

    We support PayPal and bank transfers, as well as additional options for Local Currency transfers. If you want to be paid in USD, you may want to consider a virtual provider, also known as a money transfer provider (MTP), such as Wise, Revolut and Payoneer. These are listed under our 'bank transfer' option.

    We encourage you to evaluate the different payout options on offer and choose the option that best suits your needs.

  • Are underage members and Authors allowed?

    Unfortunately, individuals under 18 years of age cannot become members or authors on Envato Market and Envato Elements.

    If you’re under 18, you will need to get a parent or guardian to buy items as a Guest or use the account of a parent or legal guardian who is at least 18 years of age, with their permission, and this adult will be responsible for all your activities.

    As per our requirements, if we receive evidence that any members are under 18, the account will unfortunately be disabled.

  • Using your Envato account for charitable purposes

    If you’d like to use your Envato Market account to engage in fundraising on behalf of a recognized, tax-deductible charitable organization, there are a few things you’ll need to consider.

    Contact the organization you wish to raise money for:

    • Let them know what you have in mind. They may have some tips and guide you on the best way to approach your project.
    • Ask them whether you need permission to use their name and trademark especially if you’ll be promoting your items on the Market by affiliating yourself with that charity.
    • They’ll also be able to help answer any questions you and customers might have about how donated funds are used. This way everyone is on the same page about your intentions.

    Decide on how you will promote the charity:

    • Be sure to include clear information about the donation details and the organization you’re supporting on your profile page and in your item description.
    • Provide as much information as possible, about the charity you’re supporting. Include a link(s) to their website, so customers can find out more about the charity and your fundraising efforts.
    • We wish you well and hope that your generosity and hard work make a positive impact on your chosen charity.
    • Please keep the charity promotion to your profile and item pages only.

    As always, any use of your Envato Market account must be in line with the Envato Market Terms and Author Terms.

  • Am I allowed to have multiple Author accounts?

    No, Authors are not allowed to have more than one Author account. If you already have more than these two accounts, please contact us to provide your account details and reasons why you require multiple Author accounts.

    Please note that additional accounts created with the intent to breach our policies will not be tolerated.

  • Why do I need to verify my identity with Author ID Checks?

    As a professional marketplace, it's critical for us to confirm the identities of our authors. This provides a trusted environment for our customers and authors to conduct business, and maintain the success of our community.

    As a new author, you will be required to complete an Author ID check to verify your identity.

    Learn more about how verification works and the steps required here.

Summary: This article explains how to apply to become an Envato Author and start selling your creative items on Envato Elements.

How to apply

results.name: What We Expect in an Envato Author
results.title: What We Expect in an Envato Author
results.body:
Summary: This outlines what we expect of an Envato Author across our platforms, including their agreement with customers and with us (Envato).

General Expectations

In order to provide the best experience and products to our global customer base, we have expectations of you, our authors and how you operate using our platforms.

We want to ensure fair and equal opportunity for all community members and ensure that there is always a high value offering for our customers. This means that when they land on Envato, your item(s) have the best chance for success in selling.

As we work on continuously managing our platforms to equip Authors to sell more items that customers want, we need you to do your part in ensuring only the best quality items are available on Envato.

If you’re new to Envato, please take some time to get to know us at All About Envato and review our general expectations below.

Authors and Customers

When a customer purchases your item, they have a right to expect that:

  • The quality will be acceptable.
  • The item is described accurately and honestly.
  • Any promises made by the author will be kept and honoured.

All members of the Envato Author Community are expected to be fair and truthful in what they say and do. All members should keep the community’s best interests at heart.

Everyone is open, straightforward, trustworthy and plays by the same rules. The information provided is clear, accurate and easy to understand.

There are consumer laws in many countries giving customers protection, that the items quality will be acceptable and works as promised. Envato customers will base their buying decision on the information provided. If the information is not accurate, then not only is a customer potentially misled, other Authors may miss out on a potential sale.

When a customer asks a pre-sales question, it’s important the information provided is clear, accurate and easy to understand. A customer can then correctly determine if the item is suitable for their project.

If a customer is misled by the item information, they may be entitled to a refund which Envato Market staff will fairly assess.

Misleading a customer may include:

  • Claiming the item has a feature or function that it does not have.
  • Advertising the item is supported, when it is not.

Please Note: If you do provide support, you’ll need to be prepared to;

  • Answer technical questions about features and functionality.
  • Help with third-party assets sold with the item (eg. bundled plugins).
  • Assist in fixing issues.

You are not required to install or customize your items or assist with hosting or third party software. Set expectations clearly in your item description for your customers on what your average response time is, for example; I will aim to respond to all requests within 48 hours. Please refer to Item Support Best Practices and the Item Support Policy if you are planning to offer Support.

When uploading your items to Envato, please ensure your item(s):

  • Works as described and matches descriptions given on the item page (or elsewhere).
  • Includes ALL the features and functionality as advertised.
  • Matches the demo or live preview.
  • Comes with full title and ownership (or properly licensed assets).

Please Note: It’s the Author’s responsibility (yours!) to ensure any applicable consumer laws are followed for the customer purchasing your item(s). This includes all claims made about the item(s) on the item page, on Envato platforms, on social media or any other sites too.

Authors and Envato

When you sign up to create an account with Envato, you agree to our Author Terms, which outline expectations of you, as an Author and how you operate on our platforms. This means for each of your items, you warrant (promise) to us that:

  1. The Item conforms to the Content Guidelines or any Supporting Materials;
  2. The Item is of acceptable quality and fit for the purpose for which it is ‘sold’;
  3. The Item matches the description given by you;
  4. You have the rights necessary to grant us the rights set out in clauses 5 and 6 of the Author Agreement;
  5. Nobody else’s intellectual property rights will be infringed by our use of the Item, our licensing of the Item to subscribers, or subscribers using the Item in accordance with the terms of the Envato Elements License (as amended from time to time);
  6. The Item complies with our Acceptable Use Policy;
  7. The Item and its description do not violate any applicable law or regulation (including those governing export control, consumer protection, unfair competition, criminal law, pornography, anti-discrimination, trade practices or fair trading);
  8. You will process a subscriber’s information in accordance with applicable privacy law and data protection regulations;
  9. If the Item preview contains watermarked previews sourced through another Envato Company site, you must ensure the following: (i) the watermark must remain on the watermarked preview; (ii) the author and name of the watermarked preview must appear in your Item description; and (iii) the watermarked preview must not be included in your Item file(s) available for download; and
  10. Where relevant, you have obtained a valid and binding model or property release for any Items requiring such a release and you must:
    • Follow the Content Guidelines or any process set out in the Supporting Materials for capturing model and property releases;
    • Retain copies of all releases and provide those copies to us upon request;
    • Provide a privacy notice, making the model aware of their personal information that you will receive and how you will handle that information;
    • Obtain the model’s permission to use their personal information;
    • Use the personal information only for the limited purposes for which the model gave permission; and
    • Meet any privacy and spam law requirements that apply to you.

These expectations include certain areas of work that you’d come across as an Author throughout your journey with us, such as:

Legal Responsibilities
Quality Expectations
Technical Requirements
The Review Process

You can find all this information by navigating to the specific sections of the Author Help Center (as listed above) and reviewing the related articles. You can also check out the Beginner's Guide to Selling on Envato to see what's involved.

results.name: Author applications are paused — new authors join by invitation only
results.title: Author applications are paused — new authors join by invitation only
results.body:
We're not accepting open applications from new authors. There's no application form to fill out, and no waitlist to join. Instead, we're inviting authors directly for a small number of categories where we need more work.

We know that's frustrating if you've been waiting to apply, and we're sorry for the inconvenience. Please check back for updates.

This means:

  • Envato Elements: not accepting new author sign-ups.
  • Envato Market: new author accounts can't be created at this time.
  • The only way to join right now is to be invited directly by Envato for a category we've identified as needing more work.

This article explains why, which categories are affected, and what you can do while open applications stay paused.

Why are open applications paused?

We’re improving how we review applications, refining our onboarding experience, and strengthening our overall category strategy across Envato Elements and Envato Market.

Pausing open applications while we redesign and moving to direct invitations helps ensure that when authors are selected for intake, we can support them with:

  • Clearer expectations
  • Better category alignment
  • Stronger opportunities for success

What does 'invitation-only' mean?

When we identify a category that needs more work, we reach out directly to creators we think are a strong fit. 

We no longer accept applications across all content types, focusing instead on a defined set of categories where customer demand is highest and where we can best support author success.

What can I do while open applications are paused?

While applications are paused, you can:

  • Explore the Author Hub to understand category trends and customer demand
  • Continue building and refining your best work
  • Prepare items that demonstrate originality, technical quality, and strong commercial relevance

Being ready ahead of time will help when applications reopen.

When will applications reopen?

We don't have a confirmed reopening date yet. When applications do reopen, the updated author application form will be available, along with guidance on eligible categories and submission requirements. 

FAQs

  • Are you still accepting applications from new authors?

    We're not accepting open applications. The only way to join as a new author right now is via our selective intake model for supported content types only.

  • Can I request an invitation, or apply to be considered?

    There's no form, waitlist, or process to request an invitation. Invitations are sent directly by Envato to creators we've identified for a specific category. Submitting work, following up, or reaching out to support won't move you into consideration.

  • Will all content categories be open when applications return?

    No. Only selected content categories will be supported when applications reopen. Requirements will vary by category, including platform availability and submission methods. These details will be shared when applications reopen.

  • What categories won’t be reopening?

    At this stage, we're not inviting authors into Theme, Code, Photo, Audio, or Graphics (with the exception of Animated Graphics and Fonts, which will open later in 2026). This is subject to change based on subscriber demand and content priorities.

  • If my content type isn't part of the current invitations, is that category being phased out?

    No. Not being part of the current intake doesn’t mean your category is being phased out or removed. We’ll continue to support and work with our existing pool of authors in those categories.

  • Will you notify me if invitations open up in my category?

    Will you notify me if invitations open up in my category? No, we won't be sending individual notifications. Keep an eye on this article for updates.

  • Can I create an account now and upload content later?

    No. While open applications are paused, you can't create a new Envato author account unless you've been invited.

  • I’m a Graphics author and want to upload LUTs. What should I do?

    LUTs sit within the Video category. Video isn't currently accepting open applications, so you'd need to be invited as a Video author.

  • Can existing authors apply to join another category during the pause?

    No. Existing authors can't apply to add new content types or categories while open applications are paused. This would require an invitation for that category, same as a new author.

  • Will you be accepting AI-generated content in the future?

    Not at this time. We're not currently inviting authors for AI-generated content. Any changes to this will be communicated through official Envato channels.

results.name: Trader Status under the EU Digital Services Act
results.title: Trader Status under the EU Digital Services Act
results.body:
Summary: Envato requires Envato Market authors to confirm whether they are a trader under the EU Digital Services Act (DSA). If an author confirms that they are a trader then Envato is required to verify and display their trader contact information on Envato Market.

What is the DSA?

The DSA is an EU law that protects consumers by increasing transparency and accountability in digital marketplaces. The DSA regulates certain digital marketplaces, such as Envato Market, who provide their services to customers in the EU.

You can find out more details about the DSA on the EU Commission website.

Who qualifies as a Trader under the DSA?

The DSA defines a trader as “any natural person, or any legal person irrespective of whether privately or publicly owned, who is acting, including through any person acting in his or her name or on his or her behalf, for purposes relating to his or her trade, business, craft or profession.”

The European Commission has issued Guidance as to what constitutes a trader (See section 2.2 ‘Concept of Trader’).

You may be considered a trader if you:

  • Regularly create and sell digital assets as a business activity
  • Operate as a freelancer, agency, or company selling creative assets
  • Consider your Envato portfolio as part of your professional income
  • Have an established business creating templates, themes, music, video assets, or other digital content
  • Have a registered business number (ie: ABN), as a company or as a sole trader

You may not be a trader if you:

  • Create and share digital assets only as a hobby or side project
  • Sell creative content occasionally as a private individual
  • Don't operate as a professional creative business
  • Share your work primarily for creative expression rather than business purposes

You must confirm whether you are a trader.

Envato Market authors must assess whether they are a trader for EU law purposes. If you determine that you are a trader, you should select “Yes, I am a trader” under the ‘Trader Status’ section when completing your Author Profile. If you are not a trader, you should select “No, I am not a trader” under the ‘Trader Status’ section when completing your Author Profile. It is your responsibility to determine whether you are a trader. Envato can’t make this determination or advise whether you are a trader. If you are unsure about your trader status, consider seeking legal advice.

If you confirm your trader status by selecting ‘Yes, I am a trader’, Envato must display your contact information on Envato Market, in accordance with EU law. This includes your name, address, email and telephone number. For registered businesses, this will also include certain business registration details. If you are a trader, you are also required to certify that you only offer products or services that comply with the applicable rules of EU law.

FAQs

What about my privacy?

The display of certain information for traders in the EU is required by law. This is a regulation that digital marketplaces, such as Envato Market, must comply with in order to offer services to customers in the EU. Any request to view your personal information is protected by Cloudflare CAPTCHA and geolocation technology, ensuring access is restricted to real users within the EU.

For more information on how we handle the information you provide to us, please see our Privacy Policy. By using Envato Market, you consent to our collection, use and disclosure of personal data and other data as outlined therein.

Can anyone see my information?

No, only customers logging in to Envato from the EU can see your name, email address and phone number.

Can I change the information displayed?

The information displayed on Envato Market is the name, address, phone and email that you have entered into our systems. If you have completed the Business Verification process, it is the Business address, name and registration number that will be displayed. It is important that the contact information that you provide to us is accurate, complete and kept up-to-date. If you would like to complete your personal or business verification again in order to change the information displayed, please contact Author Support.

Does this impact Envato Elements?

No, the DSA trader requirements do not apply to Envato Elements and Envato is not required under the DSA to display the same contact information for Envato Elements authors.

What if my trader status changes?

If your circumstances change and you need to update your trader status, click on the 'Trader declaration' link under the 'Manage your profile' section in your Author Profile.

results.body:
Summary: The steps below apply to authors who have already been approved through our intake process, as applications to become a new Author are currently closed. When applications do reopen, new authors will be able to apply via our selective intake model for supported content types only. Learn more.

Summary: This outlines our process of verifying your identity when you sign up as an author on our platforms, including step-by-step instructions using a PC/Laptop and Mobile. In order to maintain a safe and trusted environment, either personal or business verification must be completed before you become an author that is able to upload items and earn money with Envato. This notice also provides a description of the type of biometric information collected as part of the ID verification process, the purpose of collection and the retention policies for biometric information.

Please note: The ID check process described in this article applies to authors who have been approved through our intake process and are completing their onboarding steps. 

In order to maintain a safe and trusted environment, either personal or business verification must be completed before you can upload items and earn money with Envato. The steps below will guide you through the process.

How Does the ID Check Process Work?

As part of our ID check process, you will be asked to use your camera to take a picture of your ID document, and then to take a live selfie which will then be compared against your Photo ID using facial recognition technology. To achieve this, the characteristics of your face are automatically captured and compared to your Photo ID.

By completing our ID check process you confirm that you’re the person in the Photo ID and you consent to the processing of your biometric data for photo comparison purposes. You can withdraw your consent at any time by not completing the process.

If you are operating your Envato account as a registered business or company, you should choose Business Verification instead of the personal verification.

We acknowledge that such data is sensitive in nature and your Photo ID and any biometric information will only be collected and processed as outlined in this notice and our Privacy Policy in order to verify your identity using facial recognition technology and protect your rights as an author. The ID verification will be carried out by one of our third party identity verification service providers, depending on your country and the verification flow made available to you.

Our verification providers may include:

  • Veriff, based at Niine 11, Tallinn, Harjumaa, 10414, Estonia. While Veriff will not share your biometric information with us, it may share your government-issued photo ID document and your "selfie" image with us in order to satisfy our data retention obligations. You should refer to Veriff's Privacy Notice for more information on how Veriff uses the information it collects.
  • AiPrise, Inc., based at 2261 Bowers Ave, Santa Clara, CA 95051, United States. AiPrise may be used for ID checks in select countries. As part of the verification process, AiPrise may collect identity and contact information, government-issued identifiers, biometric data, including facial images and liveness detection signals, and identity documents such as your passport or driver’s licence. AiPrise will not share biometric data generated from the facial recognition process with us, but may share your government-issued photo ID document and “selfie” image with us in order to satisfy our data retention obligations. You should refer to AiPrise's Privacy Policy for more information on how AiPrise uses the information it collects.

Your biometric information will be retained by the relevant identity verification provider until the earliest of: (a) the initial purpose for which the biometric information was collected or obtained has been satisfied; or (b) three years following your last interaction with us, unless a shorter retention period is required by applicable law.

For more information on how we and our identity verification providers use, share, and retain biometric information, or to understand your privacy choices, including how to revoke your consent or request deletion of your biometric information, please contact Author Support.

Important: By agreeing to the collection and processing of your information (including biometric information) by our identity verification providers, you acknowledge and agree that: (i) you have received and had the opportunity to review a description of the type of information collected and the purpose of collection; and (ii) you consent to the collection, use, storage and retention of that information for those purposes. You also agree to receive all disclosures required by applicable privacy laws, including this notice, in electronic form.

Guidelines for completing your Author ID check

Before you begin, make sure the name in your General Information section exactly matches the name on your government-issued ID or Business Registration. Double-check your details to ensure everything is consistent.

Then, review the guidelines below to help you prepare for your Author ID check:

You’ll need a smartphone or a computer with a camera, and your government-issued ID document ready to go. Make sure that:

  • You’re using the original document (no photocopies, scans, or digital IDs).
  • All details are visible — don’t obscure or crop any part of the document.
  • You’re providing an accepted ID type for your country (e.g. passport, driver’s licence, national ID card).
  • The photo is clear (not blurry, too dark, or too light).
  • You upload the page containing your photo first.
  • The document is currently valid (not expired).
  • The document includes Latin characters.

For your selfie, please ensure that:

  • The photo is taken live and is clearly of you.
  • You’re looking directly at the camera.
  • The lighting is clear and even (not too dark, too bright, and without reflections on your face).
  • Your face is aligned within the oval on screen.

If you’re completing verification for a business account, make sure you have:

  • Your business registration documentation, such as a certificate of incorporation, partnership agreement, or tax registration document.

How do I verify my ID?

  1. Log in to your Author Dashboard and click the “Complete your ID check” section
    1. You will have to have added your tax, payout, and Trader information first. For more information on completing your payout information, see Setting Your Payout Method.
  2.  Select Complete Verification.
    1. Note that the same person who owns the Envato account and is to receive payments must also complete the ID check.

  3. Scan the QR Code on your mobile device to open the verification flow. In some cases, you may also be able to send a link to your mobile phone number, although SMS links may not be available in all countries or verification flows. Prefer to use your computer? Click “Continue with current device".

    If using a mobile, you’ll be directed to begin your ID check.

  4. Allow camera access.

    Mobile: Computer:

  5. Take photo/s of your ID document.

    Hold your document up to your webcam, center it in the viewing window and click the button to take a photo when the document is fully legible. Be sure there isn’t any glare on plastic cards. If using a drivers license or similar government ID card with a reverse side, you will be prompted to take a picture of the back of the card as well.

    Make sure your ID is fully legible in the window. If your ID is not legible, you will need to clarify what type of document you are trying to upload, and will be required to complete the above step again.

  6. Take a photo of your face

    Look straight into your camera/webcam and ensure your face is fully centered. When you're ready, click the camera button.

    Check your photo and if your face is not fully visible and clear, you can try again. Follow these tips to avoid errors:

    • Color images only: your photo must show a full, readable, color image of your document -- black & white photos or copies are not acceptable
    • Images of the physical document only: photos of screens or other photos will be rejected
    • All information on the document should be easy to read. Common issues with legibility are:
      • Glare obstructing information
      • Not enough light/too dark
      • Too far away
      • Blurry
      • Watermark over the image
      • Digitally or physically hiding or cropping information on the document

  7. Wait for your verification to process

    Once you’ve finished, your information will be uploaded into the system and then processed.

    Thanks! We'll email you when your document is verified or if any further steps are required.

    Once verified, you'll be able to operate as an Envato author and begin earning.

Business Verification

Business verification is very straightforward. You will need to upload a document that proves your registration as a genuine business, so this document can vary from country to country.

You will have to have added your payout information first. For more information on completing your payout information, see Setting Your Payout Method.

You must ensure your business/company registration document contains:

  • The name of your business, exactly as entered on your General Information when adding your payout information.
  • Your business registration number
  • The full address of your business exactly as entered on your General Information

If your business registration is in characters other than Latin, the characters still need to match exactly with your business name entered on your profile.

results.name: Setting up your Author Profile
results.title: Setting up your Author Profile
results.body:
Summary: This guide walks you through setting up your Author Profile page, managing your personal information, and preparing your account to start selling on Envato.

Welcome to Envato! We’re so happy you’re here. If you have just signed up, you will need to complete four onboarding tasks in your Author Profile to get started:

  1. Your Tax information: ensure you are charged the right amount of tax on your Envato earnings. Read more in our help section on Tax Forms if you need more information.
  2. Your payout method: let us know where to send your earnings! For more details on the payout options available to you, head to our article Getting started with the Envato payout system.
  3. Trader Declaration: we need to know if you are operating as a Trader on our platform. Learn more about this here: Trader Status under the EU Digital Services Act
  4. Your ID check: for the safety of our marketplace, we need to verify your identity. This step will become available after you have completed the above three steps. Learn more about ID checks here: Author ID Checks

These four steps will need to be completed before you can start uploading your items and earning money with Envato. Once completed, your Author Profile will be a central hub for you to manage your information, go to upload pages, and view your accumulating earnings.

 

Important: Name verification requirement

The name in your General Information must exactly match the name on your government-issued ID or Business Registration. Before you start, double-check that your details are consistent.

Mismatched names may impact your ability to get paid. 

Manage your profile

This section provides you with links to enter, or update, your tax information, payout method, and trader declaration. Once you have completed those, your ID check will become available (if you have not already completed one).

Balances

Here you can see your current earnings balances for both Envato Market and Envato Elements (if you are an Elements contributor). The balances shown are the amounts we will attempt to pay you each month and will increase with the previous month’s earnings around the 8th of the month. Check out our Market Earnings FAQs article for more information about your balances displayed in this section, and see our Introduction to Earnings article for more general information about earnings.

Envato Market Billing Information

Most of the admin required to set up your account is completed by the above 4 steps in your Author Dashboard. Your Payout method, Tax information, ID check and Trader status all apply to both Envato Market and Envato Elements (if you are approved to sell on Envato Elements).

However, if you sell items on Envato Market, you also need to fill in your Billing Information. Billing information is separate to the Tax form and only applies to Envato Market Invoices. To update this information: 

  1. Go to your Profile > Settings > Personal information from any Market Page (eg. ThemeForest, CodeCanyon, GraphicRiver)
  2. Update this page with your billing details and click save.  
Keeping your billing details accurate matters. They appear on your invoices, and we're not able to amend invoices once they've been issued. If you trade through a company, please make sure your registered company name is entered.
 
Billing details also govern sales taxes in some select countries, for more information see here: Global Tax Collection (VAT, GST & More) Information for Authors. 

Discover our ecosystem

In this section, you can learn about our different shopfronts and marketplaces and also access our Upload Guide and Upload Methods articles for information on how to upload your items.

Please note, in order to upload and publish content to Envato Elements, you must first submit an application for review. If approved, you will then be able to start uploading content to Envato Elements for the content type you were approved for. Please submit your application here. You can upload to Envato Market sites without submitting an application.

Navigation toolbar

The toolbar at the top of the screen provides links to access information about your earnings, payouts, statements, upload and portfolio management options, and community resources such as the Author Hub and Author Help Center.

results.name: Author ID Checks FAQs
results.title: Author ID Checks FAQs
results.body:
• Why do I need to verify my account?

    As a professional marketplace, it's critical for us to confirm the identities and contact information of our authors. This provides a trusted environment for our customers and authors to conduct business, and maintain the success of our community.

    As an Envato author, you will be required to complete an Author ID check to verify your identity. You will need to do this before you will be able to upload items and earn money with Envato.

  • What happens if I don’t complete an ID check?

    Unfortunately, if you do not wish to complete an ID check, or are not able to be successfully verified, you will not be able to continue earning as an Author on our platform. This is to ensure the safety and security of both authors and customers on Envato.

    Completing your ID check is a required step to ensure a safe and secure marketplace. You won't be able to upload items and earn money until your account is verified. You can complete the process at any time by visiting your Author Profile.

  • Is my information secure?

    The security of information you provide is our priority and we use technical, procedural and physical safeguards designed to protect the safety and integrity of your data.
    Our Author ID check process is supported by third party identity verification providers, such as Veriff or, in some select countries, AiPrise. These providers are required to handle information collected during the verification process in accordance with applicable privacy and information security requirements. You can refer to Veriff’s Privacy Notice or AiPrise’s Privacy Policy for more information about how each provider handles the information it collects. 

    The collection and processing of any identity data is undertaken in accordance with our Privacy Policy and any additional privacy notices or collection statements made available to you during the identity verification process.

  • What happens to my personal information after the check?

    Your ID document, selfie image and any biometric information used for facial recognition are collected by the relevant identity verification provider, such as Veriff or AiPrise. The provider will not share biometric data generated from the facial recognition process with Envato. However, it may share your government-issued photo ID document and “selfie” image with us in order to satisfy our data retention obligations.

    For more information about how your information is handled, please refer to our Privacy Policy and the privacy notice or policy of the relevant identity verification provider.

  • Will my ID information be shown publicly?

    Your ID document is not shown publicly and is not visible to anyone except verification staff for the sole purpose of your verification. In the case where you have identified yourself or business entity as a Trader, limited verified information is displayed on your Market profile only to customers based in the EU, as required by the Digital Services Act.

  • I am trying to complete the check but it shows an error or crashes - what is going wrong?

    Please make sure you are using a device with a camera (such as a laptop or a smartphone) and a supported browser (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Microsoft Edge).

    Some other things you can try if the issue persists are:

    • Ensure you are using the default camera for your device
    • Ensure your browser has access to your device camera
    • Try using a different browser, or incognito/private browsing mode (to avoid issues with cookies/caching)
    • Try using a different device

    Please DO NOT send images of your ID via email.

  • Why isn’t my government-issued ID supported by the verification system?

    We cannot verify all types of ID from all countries - some authors may have the option to use their ID card or driver’s license to complete their check, while others will need a passport.

    Some examples of IDs that may not be supported include:

    • Handwritten IDs
    • IDs that are still valid but have been superseded by newer versions (e.g. older, simple ID cards that have been superseded by newer, “smart” ID cards)
    • Alien/refugee passports
    • Digital IDs.

  • My Envato account uses my company name / I operate as a partnership - how can I complete verification?

    If your Envato account is operating as a business, you can select the Business Verification option to complete your verification check. You will need to upload a copy of your company registration details. The name of your company/entity that you have entered in your general payout information must match exactly with the name on your registration document.

    Please note that you will still need to enter a personal full name as the account holder and on your Tax form with Envato, even if you are operating as a business.

  • How will I know if I have successfully completed the check?

    You will receive an email when your check has been processed - this may take up to 48 hours after you complete your check.

  • My ID is expired, can I still use it?

    Unfortunately no, you must have a valid and current government issued ID to complete the verification process.

  • I am under 18, can I complete an ID check?

    Unfortunately as per our Author Terms, Envato’s sites and services are only available for those over the age of 18.

results.name: Photo FAQs
results.title: Photo FAQs
results.body:
• Why was my photo rejected?

    Images need to be aesthetically pleasing, well composed and offer utility to our customers.

    To avoid image rejection please also ensure your submissions meet the following criteria:

    • Feature sharp focus on the subject. Background blur and bokeh is acceptable and often desirable, but the subject should be sharp.
    • Well lit, free from harsh shadows, with contrast inside the digital sensor or film's dynamic range.
    • Properly exposed.
    • Should not contain excessive noise.
    • Should not contain moiré patterns.
    • Should not contain any chromatic aberrations or "fringing".
    • Smooth color gradients.
    • Maximum quality settings - no excessive compression artefacts.

    If you’re more of a visual learner, we’ve also put together:

    • Commercial Demand Guide
    • Most common Rejection reasons for Photos including heaps of good & bad examples
    • The Lookbook with examples of the type of photos and quality we’re looking for to further assist and inspire you.

  • How do I become a Photos Author?

    Please note: at the moment we are not currently accepting applications to become a Photos Author.

    To become a Photos Author, it all begins with a portfolio submission.

    We need to get a sense of your style and creative point of view. To facilitate that we ask all interested authors to submit a diverse portfolio of their best items for review. If approved, you’ll be invited to join our community of authors and can begin uploading your items.

    For now, authors are being hand-picked by our content experts (in time we will open this up to inbound applications too). We are specifically looking for self-curated collections in line with the Commercial Demand Guide for Photos.

    Key Selection Criteria include:

    • A consistent and high-quality photo portfolio
    • Significant initial volume and/or the ability to upload 50+ photos/month
    • Authenticity: Natural light, real people & real expressions, fresh perspective, customizable.
    • Having a link to a Dropbox or Google Drive to show us what you plan to send us once approved can really help us assess if your content is a good fit for our library. We are moving away from the microstock clichés and really focusing on photographers that produce high quality, authentic content.

      If you believe your items meet the requirements, you can then submit your interest to become a Photos Author by Applying to Become an Elements Author.

    Once your portfolio application has been approved, you will be able to submit photos for inclusion on Envato Elements.

Last revised: 1 July, 2026

About us and these terms

  1. Welcome: Hi, we’re Envato and welcome to Envato Elements, a subscription service for digital items created by designers and other creatives from around the world. We’re really glad you’re keen on becoming an Author with us.
  2. Author Terms: By becoming an Author, you agree that these Author Terms, which supplement and form part of the Envato Elements User Terms, are a legally binding agreement between us and you. Please take the time to read these Author Terms and check them regularly as they may be amended from time to time. If you do not agree to all of the Author Terms and the Envato Elements User Terms, you should not become an Author.
  3. Definitions and interpretation: Any capitalized terms will have the meanings set out in the Definitions section of these Author Terms or, if not defined in these Author Terms, have the meanings given to them in the Envato Elements User Terms (unless the context requires otherwise). If there are any inconsistencies between these Author Terms and other applicable Envato terms, these Author Terms will prevail in relation to your activities as an Author. 

As an Author on the Envato Elements you have responsibilities to us and Subscribers of your Items. Please take the time to review these Author Terms and other documents carefully.

We hope you find these resources helpful in understanding how to be a great Author on Envato Elements! 

Becoming an Author

  1. Becoming an Author is free: Becoming an Author and making your Items available on Envato Elements is free but there is a review process. There are a few things you warrant in exchange for the right to be an Author, which are outlined in these Author Terms and our other applicable terms and policies.
  2. Process to become an Author: In our Author Help Center you’ll find instructions and resources to get started as an Author (including how to apply, Author ID checks and how to start selling), along with information about payment, submission requirements and other important details about being an Author. If you are already an author on Envato Market then the process to become an Envato Elements Author may be able to be streamlined.
  3. Information and documents required: To become an Author you will need to provide information and documents so we can process and verify your application. This information may include your name, address, email address, phone number, date of birth, a government-issued photo ID document, payment information and certain tax and business information. If you do not provide the required information or we are unable to verify that information then we cannot approve your application. By providing the required information, you consent to us collecting, verifying, using, storing and displaying on our sites and products certain information about you, including to:

a. process your application to be an Author; 

b. verify your identity and, if relevant, your business registration; 

c. provide our support services to Authors and other Users and respond to queries, feedback, claims or disputes; 

d. provide you with the right to access and use Envato Elements and our other sites and products; 

e. help you publish Items or other information on Envato Elements or our other sites and products; 

f. display Author information on Envato Elements and other sites as required by applicable law; and 

g. make such disclosures as may be required for any of the above purposes or as required by applicable law, for tax or payment purposes or in respect of any claims or potential claims brought against any Group Company. 

  1. Application approval and access: If we believe the information or documents you provide are inaccurate, incomplete, or not up-to-date, we may ask you to fix it without delay. Should you fail to do so or if we reasonably believe you are violating these Author Terms or our other applicable terms or policies or any applicable laws, we may refuse to approve your application and we reserve the right to suspend, disable or terminate your account and access to our services.

The rights you grant us

  1. Your ownership and responsibility: You represent that you are the sole and exclusive owner of your Items. You will retain ownership of your Items and are solely responsible for the Items you contribute to Envato Elements (which you direct us to upload to the Envato Elements site).
  2. Appointment: You appoint us and our Group Companies as your non-exclusive distributor to sell (that is, to license and/or sub-license) your Items on Envato Elements to Subscribers worldwide on a non-exclusive basis (and as otherwise permitted under section 10).
  3. License to us: You grant us the worldwide rights:

a. to market your Items, including by reproducing, publishing, displaying, communicating and publicly performing your Items on the Envato Elements site, other sites operated by Group Companies, and in marketing and promotions about Envato or the Group Companies;

b. to make use of your Items on other sites operated by Envato or the Group Companies, in other products, features and services of Envato or the Group Companies, to develop, and enable the Group Companies to develop, new products, features and services (either independently or in collaboration with other parties), to use those products, features and services in perpetuity, and for any reasonable business purpose of the Group Companies, including to train artificial intelligence models and algorithms;

c. to unpack, decompress or otherwise access your Items, including to assess its metadata, format and properties, and to modify, alter, amend, create, translate, or improve titles, descriptions, tags, metadata, and other accompanying information for your Items, and to use Third Party Services for such purposes;

d. to make any technical or functional modifications to your Items as reasonably required, including to maintain, improve or optimise quality, performance, security, or compatibility with Envato’s requirements or services, and to use Third Party Services for such purposes;

e. to sub-license the non-exclusive rights to use the Items to Subscribers on the terms of the Envato Elements License (as amended from time to time);

f. to sub-license the non-exclusive rights to reproduce, modify, copy, publicly perform, communicate, display, broadcast, translate and transmit the Items in any format or media to enterprise Subscribers or users of sites or platforms operated, or products offered by the Group Companies (including the right to create derivative works provided that use of such derivative works is limited to Subscriber’s or user’s permitted use with respect to the Item) subject to and in accordance with agreements as we or a Group Company may negotiate with enterprise Subscribers or such other users from time to time;

g. to sub-license the non-exclusive, perpetual rights to reproduce, modify, copy, publicly perform, communicate, display, broadcast, translate and transmit the Items in any format or media to licensees or prospective licensees of any Group Companies and to allow those licensees and prospective licensees to sub-license those rights to their own customers or licensees (including the right to create derivative works provided that use of such derivative works is limited to the licensee’s or prospective licensee’s permitted use with respect to the Item) subject to and in accordance with agreements as we or a Group Company may negotiate with them from time to time; and

h. to license and sublicense the non-exclusive, perpetual rights to reproduce, modify, copy, publicly perform, communicate display, translate and transmit the Items to any Group Companies for use on other products and services operated by the Group Companies (including the Placeit service), and to sub-license the non-exclusive, perpetual rights to use the Items to customers of those products and services, on the terms and conditions of the applicable product or service, 

in each case, including the right to sub-license these rights to any Group Companies to do the same.

  1. Credit: Where practicable, we may credit you if we use your Item in marketing and promotions, but you acknowledge that this might not always be feasible depending on the circumstances.
  2. Non-exclusive basis: You agree that you contribute your Items on a non-exclusive basis. This means that nothing in these Author Terms affects your right to use or sell your Items outside of Envato Elements. If you’re an author on Envato Market, you can also be an author on Envato Elements and Placeit without impacting your Envato Market author fee. To avoid doubt however, your activities as an Envato Market author will be subject to separate Envato Market Author Terms.
  3. Affiliate program: You acknowledge that a participant in Envato’s affiliate program can use your Item thumbnail previews in their promotion of Envato Elements and that no compensation is due to you for these types of uses.

Revenue share and payment

  1. Envato pricing: We set all of the pricing for Envato Elements, including the price of subscription plans (and tiers within those plans), what subscribers get for their money, and the relative value of Items.
  2. Revenue share: As an Envato Elements Author, you will receive a share in 50% of the Net Revenue from the Base tier of Individual and Teams subscriptions to Envato Elements (the "Base Amount"), and a share in 25% of the Net Revenue from Enterprise subscriptions. Your share will be calculated using the “subscriber share” method. To avoid doubt, for Individual and Teams subscriptions purchased at any tier above the Base tier, your share is calculated only on the Base Amount, and does not include any Net Revenue attributable to amounts paid above the Base Amount. In respect of Placeit, you will receive a share in 20% of the Net Revenue from customers of Placeit, calculated using the Placeit method. Your share may be subject to income / withholding tax depending on where you live. Your share of revenue, after any deductions or withholdings referenced in these Author Terms, is referred to in these Author Terms as ‘your earnings’ or ‘earnings’.
  3. Compensation for permitted use of an Item: Where Envato receives a payment for a permitted use of an Item by a third party other than through Envato Elements or Placeit, Authors will be compensated for these uses.
  4. Free Items: Without limiting our other rights under these Author Terms, from time to time we may make Items available for free on Envato Elements or other sites operated by a Group Company to encourage people to subscribe to Envato Elements or such other sites. Any such use would be guided by the free file policy in the Author Help Center.
  5. Minimum threshold amount: We will only pay your earnings in accordance with these Author Terms once your unpaid earnings have reached the minimum threshold amount of USD$50.
  6. Payment: We will pay your earnings into your nominated bank account within thirty (30) days from the end of the month in which your earnings reached the minimum threshold amount. We will inform you of our supported payment methods from time to time. It’s your responsibility to make sure you give us accurate and up to date payment information.
  7. Payment errors: We will continue to hold your earnings if we’re not able to pay your earnings to you for whatever reason, including if:

a. we do not have the correct payment details;

b. we can’t contact you using the contact details that you have supplied;

c. you have not made a request for payment; or

d. you are asking for payment to be made to a person, an institution or a country that we’re legally prohibited from making payments to, or where there are limitations in the banking systems.

  1. Statement: We will also give you a statement setting out how your earnings have been calculated.
  2. Currency: Your earnings will be paid to you in US dollars. You are responsible for all costs of currency conversion relating to your earnings. Your financial institution does the currency conversion and may charge you additional fees outside our control.
  3. Blocked payments: We may block payment if we or our payment providers can’t make or do not support payments to your country or region. You should check what payment methods are available in your country or region for receiving payments. Envato shall not be liable for any delay or failure to pay an amount owing in such circumstances. Also, if payment is prohibited by law or otherwise restricted, your unpaid earnings may be forfeited.

Taxes

  1. Your responsibility for taxes: You are responsible for collecting and paying all taxes associated with your use of, and your transactions on, Envato Elements. Your responsibility includes any transaction taxes and withholding taxes, except to the extent we collect and remit that tax in accordance with sections 25 and 26.
  2. Transaction taxes: In any jurisdiction where we are required to collect and/or pay any GST, VAT, sales tax or other taxes that apply to transactions on Envato Elements, you acknowledge and agree that:

a. we may add the applicable tax, or make an appropriate adjustment, to the amount payable;

b. we will generally display the tax amount at checkout or on an applicable invoice, and it will be included in the total amount payable; and

c. we will collect this tax amount via any means available to us, and remit the tax to the relevant authority.

  1. Withholding taxes: We may deduct or withhold from any amount payable to you under these Author Terms, including your earnings, an amount sufficient to satisfy any taxes (including withholding taxes) which we are required to withhold under applicable law. The rate of withholding taxes will depend on the jurisdiction where you are located and whether or not an applicable tax treaty exists. You are required to pay the full amount of any amount payable by you under these Author Terms and may not deduct any applicable taxes (including withholding taxes) from that amount, unless otherwise specified in an agreement with us or an invoice we issue.
  2. Tax information: From time to time, we may request or collect information or documentation from you that may be used for tax purposes, including location information for tax residency purposes. Tax rates are calculated based on this information and the applicable tax rate at the relevant time. Any information you provide must be accurate, complete and kept up-to-date. If you do not provide or update any required information or documentation, we may withhold payments to you.

Please see our Author Help Center for more details relating to Author tax requirements.

If you have any questions or require more information about your tax obligations, please contact your local tax authority, or seek independent tax advice. We cannot provide you with tax advice.

Your, representations, warranties and responsibilities

  1. Your representations and warranties to us: You represent, warrant and covenant to us that: 

a. you are 18 years of age or over; 

b. you will follow any Author guidelines provided by us, act in good faith, and provide assistance and co-operation as we reasonably request;

c. you will not use any Envato Intellectual Property, including any trademark or trade name, in connection with your Items, your account or otherwise without our prior written consent or as expressly permitted under these Author Terms or our trade mark guidelines;

d. the information you provide us (including your name, address, email address, phone number and, if applicable, government issued ID document and tax and business registration details), is accurate, complete and up-to-date; 

e. you are not located in a country which is subject to international sanctions such as those imposed by the US Government, the European Union, the Australian Government or the United Nations, and are not on a sanctioned persons list; and

f. you will not use a virtual private network or VPN or any other means to avoid compliance with these Author Terms, or for any fraudulent or illegal reasons.

  1. Item representations and warranties: You represent, warrant and covenant to us that:

a. each Item conforms to the Content Guidelines and Supporting Materials (including Quality and Technical Requirements and policies and terms relevant to your Item);

b. the Item matches the description given by you;

c. you have all rights, licenses, releases, consents and authorizations necessary to grant us the rights set out in these Author Terms;

d. our use of the Item, including licensing the Item to subscribers, and our subscriber’s use of the Item (in accordance with the Envato Elements License), will not infringe any rights (including third party intellectual property rights or rights of publicity) ;

e. each Item complies with our Acceptable Use Policy;

f. each Item and its description do not violate any applicable law or regulation (including those governing export control, consumer protection, unfair competition, criminal law, pornography, anti-discrimination, trade practices, fair trading or privacy);

g. if an Item preview contains watermarked previews sourced through another Group Company site, you must ensure the following: (i) the watermark must remain on the watermarked preview; (ii) the Author and name of the watermarked preview must appear in your Item description; and (iii) the watermarked preview must not be included in your Item file(s) available for download; 

h. each Item does not contain viruses or other computer codes, files or programs which are designed to limit or destroy the functionality of other computer software or hardware; and

i. if an Item includes a use of a model, location or property, you have obtained a valid and binding model or property release from the model, or the owner or licensor of the location/property and you must:

i. comply with all Content Guidelines and Supporting Materials, including our model and property release policy that are necessary for capturing model and property releases;

ii. retain copies of all releases and provide those copies to us upon request;

iii. provide a privacy notice to the model, making the model aware of their personal information that you will receive and how you will handle that information;

iv. obtain the model’s written permission to use their personal information;

v. use the personal information only for the limited purposes for which the model gave permission; and

vi. meet any privacy and spam law requirements that apply to you.

  1. Indemnity: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless each Group Company from and against any and all losses, costs (including legal costs), expenses, demands, settlement damages or liability that a Group Company incurs arising out of, or in connection with, a third party claim against a Group Company alleging that any Items you provide, license or otherwise made available through Envato Elements or to any Group Company infringes, misappropriates or otherwise violates any third party’s rights, including intellectual property rights and rights of publicity.

Managing Envato Elements

  1. Item review: We have rules about what Items we accept and don’t accept and you can read up on how the review process works. We aim to give constructive feedback and may ask you to make changes, but acceptance of any Item is at our reasonable discretion and we have the final say. We may reject (or later remove) Items that don’t meet our quality, technical, legal or policy requirements. Where required by applicable law, we will provide a statement of reasons and information on how to raise a complaint; otherwise, we may provide feedback at our discretion.
  2. Item removal: We may remove an Item at our reasonable discretion, including for catalogue curation, quality or technical standards, errors or misrepresentations, suspected or actual breaches of these Author Terms or third-party rights, or other policy or legal concerns. We will give prior notice where required by applicable law and may otherwise provide notice at our discretion. Where required by applicable law, we will provide a statement of reasons and information on how to raise a complaint. Removing an Item does not by itself terminate your account or access to the service. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from Item removal.
  3. No liability for Item use: We are not responsible for the way that Subscribers or other Users use the Items on Envato Elements or any other sites operated by Group Companies, or the way end users interact or use an End Product that incorporates an Item.
  4. Copyright infringement: 

a. If you would like to submit a notification of alleged infringement of your Items on the Envato Elements, you must first send us a DMCA takedown notice pursuant to our DMCA Policy.

b. In the event Envato receives a notification of alleged infringement about one or more of your Items, Envato may suspend access to any or all of your Items pursuant to our DMCA Policy.

c. If you knowingly or repeatedly submit false copyright infringement claims and takedown notices to Envato that we consider in our reasonable discretion to be false, Envato reserves the right to disable or delete your account with no further notice to you.

Termination

  1. Suspension or termination: We hope that you will be with us for a long time. But we may, using our reasonable discretion, decide whether or not your actions comply with these Author Terms. We can suspend or terminate your participation as an Author on Envato Elements at any time for any reason (acting reasonably), including:

a. if you breach these Author Terms or any other applicable terms or policies;

b. if we believe any information or documents provided by you are inaccurate, incomplete, or not up-to-date;

c. if you breach any applicable laws, rules or regulations;

d. if you act in a way that does not align with the values of our community including:

i. engaging in serious or illegal misconduct (such as criminal or fraudulent activities); or

ii. infringing the intellectual property rights of others; or

iii. breaching our Community Guidelines; or

e. if you act in a way that could cause harm to any Group Company or any user of a site operated by a Group Company, including: 

i. any public conduct or activity (such as public communications) that would adversely affect the reputation of any Group Company; and/or

ii. any threats of harm or damage to any user of any product or service of a Group Company. 

If we decide to terminate your Envato account, you must not apply for a new account as you will no longer be welcome in our community. This decision may also apply to your use of other sites (as an author or a user) operated by any Group Company. Authors have the right to raise any concerns using our complaint-handling system if they are suspended or denied access to Envato Elements. Additionally, we may cancel unverified accounts or accounts that have been inactive for a substantial period of time.

Miscellaneous

  1. Changes to these terms: We may change these Author Terms at any time.  We will post the current version of these Author Terms on our website and will update the “Last revised” date at the top of these Author Terms.  We will provide you with reasonable prior notice of any changes to the Author Terms that materially adversely affect your rights or your use of Envato’s services, before they take effect.
